title: Reproducible graph and reference
contract: Restore the real dataset and capture a trustworthy oracle before replacing Python.

title: One real brain in the browser
contract: The first useful browser checkpoint shows one graph-driven fly and measured neural values.

title: One sensory environment
contract: All cues and physical wind use the same geometry-aware field owner.

title: Finite life and physical escape
contract: Eating extends a finite reserve; only crossing the exit scores.

title: Twenty flies with buffered replay
contract: A complete 20-fly attempt plays smoothly from bounded compact records.

title: Close framing and shared selection
contract: Model/card selection enters close follow; zoom preserves follow and only the yellow world ring marks pointer selection.

title: Blender fly and replacement workbench
contract: A true 3D fly remains recognizable at close zoom and can be replaced without application changes.

title: Playback-driven fly animation
contract: Walking, flying, landing and eating are recognizable without animation changing simulation.

title: Readable white trails
contract: All small flies can be followed through recent recorded paths.

title: A readable 3D house
contract: Room walls, doorways, dead ends and solid props are real meshes driven by authoritative geometry.

title: House materials and color
contract: Cool home surfaces, readable flies and a warm orange exit establish the approved direction.

title: Depth and exit lighting
contract: Lighting makes the 3D room readable while the exit remains a clear focal point.

title: All-fly science and explanations
contract: Every fly card shows both grouped network activity and time traces synchronized with the world.

title: Editable setup and attempt loop
contract: Players can place a fixed inventory, run, inspect results and retry with their setup intact.

title: Level 1 is the tutorial
contract: The first complete five-room game teaches placement through an easy, winnable layout.

title: Four more authored puzzles
contract: Five sequentially unlocked levels grow in rooms and decisions; food sustains larger-map routes.

title: Browser release and clean cutover
contract: A static build contains the complete game, real graph, models and reproducible evidence.
